findings.summary: P2: inheritedProviderUpdatePaths.history and the provider-aware branch ownership history scan use git log --full-history without explicit merge diffs. An isolated fixture using the production proof and ownership functions changed a canonical foreign Task README only in one merge resolution and restored it only in another merge resolution. Final bytes matched R. The plain history contained only own.txt; inheritedProviderUpdatePaths incorrectly returned the foreign README and assertBranchTaskArtifactOwnership accepted it. This violates the required preservation of pre-update ownership and complete path lineage. Add explicit --diff-merges=separate to both remaining history scans and add a genuine two-merge edit/restore regression using the existing provider proof test fixture.

The completed scope admission helper now explicitly selects separate merge diffs. Its source-only/reverted refusal and README-only positive cases under log.diffMerges=off passed focused checks. Native full009 passed on30e2df44. Those results do not cover the newly reproduced provider lineage bypass.
